name: "Cheese Board" Bento Box with Candied Pecans, Dates, Grapes, Cucumbers & Hummus

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes a 4-compartment bento box. Please adjust the recipe as needed to accommodate the size of your bento box or food storage containers.
Place pecans and dates in the small compartments of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup candied pecans
⅓ cup medjool dates, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and cut cucumber into sticks. Place hummus in a small container with a lid. Place both in the medium compartment of the bento box.
Wash and dry grapes. Cut jack cheese into thin slices. Place grapes, both cheeses, and crackers in the large compartment of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup green grapes
2 oz colby jack cheese
1 mini wheel brie cheese
½ cup woven wheat cracker

instructions.primary_message: Cover bento box and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy!
